profile.headline: Seasoned Software Developer looking for new engagement
profile.summary:
•	An accomplished Software Developer specializing in Object-Oriented Programming with extensive experience in the full life cycle of the software development.
•	Almost 19 years of experience in ASP.Net programming with C# backend.
•	Over 10 years of experience in Web Forms development using ASP.Net with C# backend.
•	Over 3.5 years of experience in MVC3 development using ASP.Net with C# backend.
•	Over 6 years of experience in MVC4 development using ASP.Net with C# backend. 
•	Strong ability to adapt to different situations and problems quickly.
•	Capable of working on a team or independently on projects.
•      Experience as lead developer
•	Active Top Secret Clearance.
•	Previously CompTIA Security+ certified

SKILLS
•	Operating Systems: Windows XP/7/10/11, Windows Server 2008R2/2012/2016/2022
•	Databases: Microsoft SQL Server 2005/2008/2010/2012, Oracle 11g/12c/19c
•	Programming Languages and Designs: C#, ASP.Net, MVC 3/4/5, Web Forms, HTML, HTML5, Javascript, jQuery, Linq, CSS, XML, ASP, SharePoint 2010 Development, Java, VB.Net, Visual Basic 6, YAML
•	Software: Visual Studio 2008/2010/2015/2017/2019/2022, Team Foundation Server,  IIS 6/7.5/10/11, JIRA, SQL Developer, SharePoint 2010, Ansible Automation Platform, GitLab, Git
•	Tools: Entity Framework 4/5/6, Entity Spaces, SQL Server Reports, Telerik Controls (both Web Form and MVC Extensions), IronPDF, DEVExpress, MVC Controls, Open Office Xml, Open Office Xml Power Tools, EPPlus, ReSharper, Cognos SDK, NUnit (Unit Testing), LDAP
•	Software Development Patterns: Agile, Waterfall, SCRUM, MVP (Model View Presenter), TDD (Test Driven Development)

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked as an Application Developer for the CHESS (Computer, Hardware, Enterprise Software, and Solutions) team
•	The project is part of an Army contract to ALTESS
•	Worked on resolving bugs within the OSNAP Reports (Order Transaction Report), including population of certain data fields and cleaning up DB transactions

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
•	Worked as a .Net Developer of the CLASS (Consular Lookout and Support System) team
•	Assigned to the Namecheck team
•	Assisted  in upkeep of the web applications, web services, and windows services for Namecheck
•	Assisted with security improvements to the web application QueueBRT
 
•	Assisted with improvements in performance with the web service called CLASS Web Service (CLAWS)
•	Assigned to oversee both QueueBRT and CLAWS improvements/changes
•	Promoted to Lead .Net Developer of the CXI (CLASS External Interfaces) (another member of CLASS)
•	Oversaw both web services and web applications belonging to the Gateway team (last member of CLASS)
•	Supervised two .Net Developers, along with two testers for CXI team
•	Worked to migrate a list of 29 older .Net Framework and .Net Core applications to use .Net Framework 4.8 and .NET 8
•	Created Ansible Playbooks that would automate the deployment of applications to different environments (development, QA, integration, final testing, and production)
•	Assisted with creation of Ansible Playbooks that would upgrade the .Net Framework or .NET version on the server to the required (.Net Framework 4.8 and .NET 8)
•	Assisted with creation of Ansible Playbooks that would check the ODAC (Oracle Data Access) installed on the server and help pick the appropriate to use with each application
•	Assisted with creation of Ansible Playbook that would uninstall the older versions of .Net Core and .NET (primarily 3.1 and 6)
•	Standardized turnovers to QA testers for .Net Developers
•	Assisted with onboarding Ansible Playbooks into AAP (Ansible Automation Platform)
•	Updated Ansible Playbooks to be usable within AAP
•	Assisted in standardization of Ansible Playbooks for the onboarding process to AAP
•	Oversaw testing of all 29 .Net applications belonging to CXI and Gateway teams on multiple occasions
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Web Services · Windows Services · ASP.NET Web Forms · Ansible

positions.title: Lead .Net Developer
positions.description:
•	Lead developer on maintaining MVC4 web app called BRACMIS.
•	Set up a development environment for developers outside of staging/test and production environments for BRACMIS
•	Set up a development environment for a staging/test area for BRACMIS.
•	Set up a Team Foundation Server (TFS) site for BRACMIS (previously used Git but was no longer in any form of source control).
•	Set up procedures for deployments for BRACMIS to Production environment.
•	Worked on continuously updating the source code for BRACMIS to reflect industry standards.
•	Worked with teammate in maintaining and operating Oracle Database for BRACMIS.
•	Implemented Unit Testing using NUnit
•	Worked on Unit Testing all pieces of BRACMIS that could be Unit Tested into the Unit Tests
•	Supervised mid-level developer for BRACMIS project.
•	Instituted Code Reviews for check ins to TFS.
•	Worked closely with customer in defining requirements for BRACMIS
•	Completed CompTIA Security+ certification

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
•	Worked on maintaining MVC3 web app called The VUE (Visual User Environment).
•	Developed architecture for secondary office for VUE called SCNGO.
•	Helped in development of OCM module.
•	Worked on redesigning the AOP module using Open Office Xml.
•	Worked on a team for revamping VUE.
•	Worked on a team for dealing with maintenance of VUE.
•	Worked on developing a new interface for the web app called VUE.
•       Created spin off version of the VUE's eLibrary called Key Library.
•       Part of a great team that introduced use of SCRUM to the development process.

positions.title: .Net Developer/Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked on revamping an old Access program called SOSNG into an MVC3 web app that is used for updating inventory of devices within CJIS.
•	Worked on revamping an old Access program called Supply Catalog into an MVC3 web app that is similar to an Amazon store.
•	Worked on Phase 2 of Supply Catalog to fit the needs of customers.
•	The newly revamped web app is stood upon an MVC3 web app called Nop Commerce.
•	Obtained Top Secret Clearance to work on FBI sites.

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
•	Participated in creation of new ASP.Net pages with C# backend for a website named Knowledge Now.
•	Participated in maintaining older ASP and ASP.Net pages within the system.
•	On many team projects that consisted of two or more members in developing newer modules for Knowledge Now.
•	Worked independently on some smaller projects for Knowledge Now.
•	Part of a team that developed modules to be run on a SharePoint 2010 system.
•	Obtained Secret Clearance to work on Air Force and NASA Knowledge Now sites.

positions.title: Assistant Technician
positions.description:
•	Assisted in maintenance of older Visual Basic 6 code to process document images.
•	Ran custom Visual Basic 6 application to clean up document images.
•	Aided in delivering document images to customer.

honors.description: This was awarded to the team for helping with the transition of the Re-Organization within the DOE.
